## [The two stars is because I’ve had a…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/647f7142c4234462867175d2)
The two stars is because I’ve had a significant problem with “white glove delivery,” which I think the company requires to to purchase, involves taking it out of the box, taking it to the room of your choice, and removing the box. White glove delivery is quite expensive. 

I had an order of several pieces, and had been in touch with the company to schedule the date and window for the delivery. About a week prior to our scheduled date, one of the pieces was delivered while I was not home. It was a large, heavy 6 foot tall box, and they placed it leaned up against my front door, completely blocking off my front door. Leaving me with a large package/box which is difficult for me to move, then having to get the item into my house and upstairs where it belongs, and deal with all the packaging.

May 30, 2023
